personArchives.name: Knuth: Programs to Read
personArchives.basis: Author's Stanford page publishes his CWEB program sources with individual descriptions and dates.
personArchives.description: Author-hosted CWEB source programs, algorithms, combinatorics and mathematical experiments.

personArchives.licenseNote: Do not assume one uniform license for every linked program.

personArchives.name: Improved Noise reference implementation
personArchives.basis: NYU-hosted page explicitly names Ken Perlin and presents the Java reference implementation for his SIGGRAPH 2002 paper.
personArchives.description: Original Java reference implementation of improved Perlin noise.
personArchives.licenseNote: Code carries a 2002 Ken Perlin copyright notice; a permissive license was not verified. Label as public reference code, not automatically open source.

personArchives.name: Bridson graphics and simulation code
personArchives.basis: Author's UBC faculty page names Robert Bridson and directly provides code downloads under Software.
personArchives.description: Curl noise, fast Poisson disk sampling, PIC/FLIP fluids, collision detection and geometry reference code.
personArchives.licenseNote: Faculty page explicitly calls the curl-noise example code and included Poisson sampling implementation public domain; do not extend that claim to all downloads.

personArchives.name: Nervous System OBJExport
personArchives.basis: Official tool page explicitly credits Jesse Louis-Rosenberg as author and links this repository.
personArchives.description: Processing library for exporting color meshes as OBJ and X3D.
personArchives.recentEvidence: Official tool page lists v0.2.4 dated 21 April 2013; this is archival evidence, not a recent activity claim.
personArchives.licenseNote: Check the repository license before reuse. The studio's general Creative Commons statement is not a repository-specific license audit.

studioAssociations.basis: Official studio page names Jessica Rosenkrantz and Jesse Louis-Rosenberg as founders and describes releasing source code.
studioAssociations.limitation: Studio association only. OBJExport's official author credit is Jesse Louis-Rosenberg; do not imply Jessica authored it or treat the studio account as her personal GitHub.
